text:
rui: Quick note: generator ergonomics in the Go SDK are surprising — ctx cancel doesn't always terminate background auth refreshers.
neha: saw that in the onramp sample app. goroutine count grows after repeated cancel/restart loops.
omar: can you paste repro or stack?
rui: gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/go-gen-2155. stack shows auth.refresher stuck in select on time.After + connChan.
neha: probable cause: refresher tied to connection lifecycle only; request ctx cancel doesn't close conn immediately.
omar: two fixes: (1) accept a ctx in startRefresher so callers can cancel early, (2) change sampleapp to return a stream handle with Close().
ci-bot: checklist: add unit test for many short-lived streams, update sampleapp README to show defer stream.Close().
neha: I'll update docs; omar can handle refresher change.
rui: filed issue and linked gist. we'll discuss whether default should change or be opt-in.
